topic: Finding the total bill from an equal per-person share
core_question: Seven friends each pay $16 to cover a group dinner. What is the total bill, in dollars?
answer_summary: the total of $112 (7 people paying $16 each)
persona: skeptical and testy; texting quickly with typos here and there
